item.title: Parse hosts with urlsplit, not partition
item.content: To split a host/port that may be an IPv6 literal, use urlsplit(f"//{value}") and read .hostname/.port instead of .partition(":"), which breaks on bracketed IPv6 addresses.

item.title: Check port is not None, not truthy
item.content: When deriving a port from a parsed URL, test `sn_port is not None` rather than truthiness so that port 0 is preserved.
